parent_result: WSCM-DTR-EFFECT-PARTITION-01 archived deterministic compression; conventional CART zero terminal error, no superior intelligence
hypothesis: Reuse greedy learned action-effect partitions as immutable banks. With stochastic outcomes and changed partitions, pooling improves prediction over unpooled counts without sacrificing exact-Bayes/CART accuracy or cold-return performance.

world_families: unstructured B with 8 independent context response pairs
no-change B identical to A null
generator.A: 8 shuffled context IDs assigned to 3 nonempty classes (size3,3,2); each class independently sampled two Bernoulli probabilities from {.1,.2,.3,.7,.8,.9}; distinct class response pairs
generator.B: repartition: independently shuffled 4 groups of size2 and four distinct response pairs; unstructured: 8 distinct response pairs; null: identical to A
generator.observations: 128 A +128 B +32 return to A per world; 8/8/2 independently shuffled complete blocks of 16 context-action pairs; independent Bernoulli draw for each observed consequence; generation uses isolated SHA256-domain deterministic Random
generator.budget: 12 worlds, 3456 witnessed synthetic outcomes; identical rows to all arms, no original source calls
generator.boundary: All methods know A and B fitting session boundaries; no regime identity given to recall router, equal prior over two frozen banks. A-return evaluator identity not provided to router. No closed-loop probe selection.

arms: greedy partition: exact unchanged parent greedy(), pool counts by discovered groups, immutable A and B banks
full context/action Beta table with same two frozen banks and routing
exact BMA over all 4140 context partitions with same Beta priors and routing

fully grown binary-feature CART (greedy squared-error split with positive gain, deterministic tie; leaf empirical mean), same two banks and recall routing; clip to [1e-6,1-1e-6] only for likelihood routing
pooled full context/action Beta (A+B combined, ignores regime; negative)

scoring.primary: expected Bernoulli excess Brier mean (prediction-p_true)^2 over all 16 equally weighted cells for A and B trained banks, average per world then seed; report full expected Brier too or irreducible floor; evaluator law never fed learner
scoring.return: after 0,8,16,32 witnessed return outcomes, use frozen two-bank Bernoulli likelihood mixture in log domain; predictions are scored against private A law across 16 cells; no updates to banks; report mean drift vs original A bank and max world drift at 32; report A weight, no-change null separately
scoring.compression: candidate logical probability cells plus actual canonical JSON serialized bank bytes vs full bank, separately; exact partition count; measure fit wall time in log only, do not claim timing parity from deterministic outputs
scoring.integrity: cold restore both frozen bank snapshots via JSON and reconstruct predictions, exact parity; no mutation across recall; no hidden source law to fit or route; no protected first use

gates.seed_gap_vs_exact_and_cart: <=.002 vs strongest exact BMA/CART each seed
gates.unstructured_B_harm: mean candidate excess Brier <= best full/exact/CART +.01
gates.compression: mean <=12 probability cells per fitted bank
gates.negative: all gates required to continue; otherwise DEV_NO_GO, no tuning this consumed cohort. Even pass is synthetic development only, not scientific acceptance.
